wafProbeResult: Cloudflare passive — cf-ray on every batch, all 200s on the catalog/home/sitemap, no challenges fired. Honeypot/SQLi/XSS payloads silently absorbed by Shopify routing. Batch 8 (no-UA) returned 403/4515b which is Cloudflare's standard reject-empty-UA reflex; Shopify's normal traffic uses a UA so this does not affect crawls.

cfHeaders: cf-ray on home, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, all desktop+mobile+bot+curl probes

watermark.reason: Shopify global /products.json default order is published_at DESC (verified: husqvarna-1640-fullstock created 2026-02-24 but published 2026-05-07 appears at position 2 ahead of older-published items — confirms Mistake 32 published_at not created_at). Storefront sort ?sort_by=created-descending is honored on /collections/* pages (counter-control proven: default firearms first product copy-of-charles-daly differs from sort=created-descending first product sauer-s100 AND differs from counter-control sort=title-ascending first product a-allan-sxs). No Shopify storefront API exposes a published_at_min filter, so this is navigate-from-watermark, not api-date-since-watermark.

topLevelCategories.totalsSumCheck: Sum of per-category counts = 3,669. Walked union of 31 collections = 3,143 unique. Global /products.json walk = 3,157. Coverage = 99.6% (14 products missing from per-category union — merchant-side tagging gap, e.g. /products/1911-auto-magazine has product_type Magazines but is not in /collections/magazine which targets Magazine singular). Cross-category overlap inside the union ~14.1% (517 products tagged in 2+ collections, typical for Shopify smart-collection model where caliber-level subcategories sit beneath /collections/firearms). Within the skill's 5% drift gate.

stageNotes: Stage 1 (Canonical URL): apex 200, www 301 -> apex (Shopify canonical_host_redirection x-redirect-reason header), <link rel=canonical href=https://intersurplus.com/> agrees -> canonicalOrigin = https://intersurplus.com.

Stage 2 (WAF + CAPTCHA): 8-batch probe — Cloudflare passive (cf-ray on every batch, all 200), Shopify origin (powered-by + cdn.shopify), no challenge body markers, no Sucuri/Incapsula/Akamai/MalCare. Batch 8 no-UA returned 403/4515b — Cloudflare standard, not site-specific. CAPTCHA: hCaptcha bootstrap script present (captcha-bootstrap inline JS targeting contact/account forms) -> hasCaptcha=true, captchaType=hcaptcha. CAPTCHA gates form submission, NOT catalog browsing — does not block crawl.

Stage 3 (Platform): Shopify confirmed by Shopify.shop = survivalsurplus-ca.myshopify.com, cdn.shopify.com, _shopify_* cookies, powered-by: Shopify header. Theme = Debut. adapterType=shopify. No age-gate detected in homepage HTML. Maintain verifyMethod=detail-page (Shopify Admin API requires auth; storefront fallback is per-page Playwright).

Stage 4 (Catalog URLs): /collections.json returned 111 collections; homepage nav exposes 68 /collections/* links across an Ammunition link, Bayonets link, and a Firearms mega-dropdown plus secondary groupings. After dropping aggregators (/collections/all, /collections/all-firearms — 100% subset of /collections/firearms; /collections/fire-arms — 30-06 caliber masquerading as parent) and caliber-level subcategories (those nest under /collections/ammunitions and /collections/firearms), 31 leaf or mid-level collections selected. Coverage walk: union of 31 = 3143 of 3157 (99.6%); 14 missing are merchant-side tagging artifacts (econo-bundles, 1911-auto-magazine product_type Magazines vs /collections/magazine Magazine). Within the 5% gate.

Stage 4g (Extraction quality): 3 products sampled from /collections/firearms page 1 (positions 0, 16, 31 of 32 cards). All four fields populated for each: title (real product names — Stevens Pump Shotgun, Carl Gustaf 80, CZ 452-EM), absolute URL, price (numeric), stockStatus (all 3 sold-out — high out-of-stock rate is normal for this surplus retailer). Sample URLs verified GET 200.

Stage 5 (Pagination): /collections/firearms page 1 returns 32 products. Tested ?page=2 -> 32 different products, zero-overlap with page 1. type=query, template=page, firstPageHasParam=false (page 1 is bare URL), startPage=1, zeroIndexed=false. perPage=32 from the default storefront grid (Shopify Debut theme).

Stage 6 (Sort): <select name=sort_by id=SortBy> exposed 9 standard Shopify options (manual, most-relevant, best-selling, title-asc/desc, price-asc/desc, created-asc/desc). 3-outcome counter-control test on /collections/firearms: default first 3 (copy-of-charles-daly, baikal-ij-26e, squires-bingham) ne sort=created-descending first 3 (sauer-s100, fabarm-o-u, lincoln-premier) ne sort=title-ascending first 3 (a-allan-sxs, copy-of-charles-lancaster, a-e-bayliss). Both differ from default -> sort honored. sortParam=?sort_by=created-descending. Note Mistake 32: Shopify storefront created-descending actually orders by published_at (verified: /products.json default order has husqvarna-1640 created 2026-02-24 but published 2026-05-07 appearing at position 2). The runtime crawler should treat created-descending as the published_at ordering.

Stage 7 (Watermark): Method B (navigate-from-watermark). Sort honored upstream (Stage 6). Date source available via product.published_at on every /products.json item AND on every /collections/<h>/products.json item. Method A (api-date-since-watermark) is NOT available because Shopify storefront /products.json does not accept ?published_at_min= or any date-since filter. The crawler must paginate /products.json?limit=250&page=N newest-first to find the watermark, then walk back to index new products.

Stage 8 (Product count): /products.json walk returned 13 pages x 250 (last page partial) = 3,157 unique products. productCountMethod=shopify-products-walk (canonical for Shopify per harness order #3). /products/count.json not tested but skill notes it usually 401s on storefront.

Stage 9 (Assembly): all 9 required validator fields present; 7 recommended fields present (sortParam, sortVerified, perPage, paginationPattern, crawlers.*, topLevelCategories, lastVerified). One judgment call to flag for operator: catalogUrls coverage is 99.6% (14 products short of global). Operator may accept this as merchant-side tagging gap, OR add /collections/all as a catchall (Rule C trade-off — the rule discourages aggregator URLs but Shopify smart-collections sometimes leak orphans).
